tool: Headless Google Chrome 155.0.8059.82 driven over the DevTools protocol, plus the Claude desktop in-app browser pane (version not exposed)
scope: Desktop browser responsive emulation, not physical mobile device evidence

observations.note: Before clipping the hero glow, scroll width was 395; main now clips horizontal overflow.
Shared header, footer and buttons render; no layout regression observed against the pre-change capture.

interactions: Mobile menu opens (aria-expanded true) and closes with Escape (aria-expanded false).
Workflow tabs: End key selects and focuses Update; filename becomes 'terminal — release workflow'.
Try an update reaches 'Example update applied. Same native app.' at v1.1; Reset restores v1.0 and the original button label including its arrow icon.
Hero pointer movement sets bounded --hero-x and --spotlight-x values in the in-app browser.
visual_result: Warm light palette, serif accent headlines and fox retained. Hero devices show distinct iOS and Material 3 idioms; platform section pairs MixerUI declarations with native-style renderings; minimum label size raised to 11-12px.
